reason: A DSH browser plugin that alerts users when agent turns or background jobs finish by playing a synthesized chime and updating the hidden tab title.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中通过提示音和标签页标题变化提醒用户智能体回合或后台任务已完成。
summaries.en: Alerts users in the DSH web interface when agent turns or background jobs finish using a synthesized chime and tab-title updates.

capabilities: Listens for agent-turn and background-job completion events in the DSH web interface
Plays a synthesized completion or failure chime
Updates the browser tab title when the page is hidden and restores it when visible
